about: Declared-logic ROM tables for tools/mem_compiler/rom_infer_gate.py. OWNER D-ROM-2 = (a), 2026-10-25 20:26 PDT: fixed math function tables stay synthesised logic (identical in every instance, 0 cycles); every other read-only memory >= 1 kbit synthesised to logic FAILS. sha256 = SHA-256 of the Yosys $mem_v2 INIT parameter bit string (as ORFS mem.json writes it). A new entry needs an owner/COORD decision recorded in coord lanes/PLAN-DELTA.md; never add weight tables, calibration/schedule images or per-die content here.
